findings.criterion: A `source=local` PASS returns `signature.signed is False` and a machine-readable unsigned reason naming the local-source policy; an interface test asserts both.
findings.detail: The implementation at `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/__init__.py:722` correctly sets `verdict["signature"] = {"signed": False, "reason": "local-source-never-signs"}`. However, the interface test `test_local_source_pass_is_never_signed` (lines 1715–1725) only asserts `verdict["signature"]["signed"] is False`. It contains NO assertion on the `reason` field (e.g. `verdict["signature"]["reason"] == "local-source-never-signs"` or similar). The AC requires the interface test to assert BOTH `signed is False` AND the machine-readable reason. Only half is tested.
findings.remediation: Add an assertion `assert verdict["signature"].get("reason") == "local-source-never-signs"` (or equivalent) to `test_local_source_pass_is_never_signed`.

findings.criterion: A table-driven never-sign test covers BLOCK, INDETERMINATE, degraded, local-source, and explicit `sign=False`.
findings.detail: `test_never_sign_guard_table` (lines 1586–1626) is the only table-driven never-sign test. It covers only three of the five required cases: BLOCK (a), INDETERMINATE (b), and sign=False (c). Its docstring explicitly states: "NOTE: `source="local"` is deliberately ABSENT" (line 1590–1593, a stale pre-fix comment). Degraded is covered in a SEPARATE test `test_sign_plan_review_refuses_non_certifiable_verdicts`, and local-source is in another separate test `test_local_source_pass_is_never_signed`. The AC requires a SINGLE table-driven test covering all five: BLOCK, INDETERMINATE, degraded, local-source, and sign=False. Neither local-source nor degraded are in the table, so the criterion is not met.
findings.remediation: Add a `("local-source", rebar.llm.review_plan(..., source="local", ...))` case and a `("degraded", ...)` case directly into the `cases` list in `test_never_sign_guard_table`, and update/remove the stale "deliberately ABSENT" docstring note.
